name: 48235 · Detroit, MI
findings: ZIP 48235 (Detroit) has 188 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48235 (Detroit) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 40 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
